name: Clear 'em Out
summary: Gelinda Coppergleam wants the dragons cleared from a cave rich in mineral deposits. She offers a reward and a share if her mining venture turns a profit.

sections.title: A Cave Venture
sections.body: Gelinda Coppergleam has found mineral deposits in the cave behind her, but Cinderscale dragons are in the way. She asks you to clear them out so she can bring in a mining crew. In return, she offers a reward and promises you a cut if the venture earns a profit.

faq.answer: Gelinda Coppergleam is planning a mining venture in a cave rich with mineral deposits.

faq.q: What does Gelinda want cleared out?
faq.answer: Gelinda asks you to clear the Cinderscale whelps and warriors from the cave.
The cave has untapped mineral deposits, along with Cinderscale whelps and warriors.
Gelinda offers a reward and promises you a share once her mining venture turns a profit.
